The '''Colicoid Creation Nest''' was the primary [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company on [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]] during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The Colicoid Creation Nest was operated by the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]], who developed their [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] in their own image. The Nest also designed the [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]] used during the Clone Wars, as well as the [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Scorpenek annihilator droid]], and many other powerful variants of droids. Divisions of the Nest included [[Colla Designs/Legends|Colla Designs]] and [[Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries/Legends|Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries]].

In [[54 BBY/Legends|54]] to [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], for the first [[Time/Legends|time]] in at least [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], two Colicoid representatives of the Creation Nest attended the [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], a meeting hosted by [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask II]] between various influencial organizations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that ranged from legitimate corporations to syndicates of the criminal underworld.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
